case_title: NICOLETTE JEANNE GAMACHE VS. TERESA NITTOLO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,710.30 FILED BY GAMACHE, NICOLETTE JEANNE AS TO DEFENDANT NITTOLO, TERESA DBA MOLTE COSA AND BELLA COSE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-09-2015 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE FOR SERVICE:$65.00 SERVED DEC-12-2014, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT NITTOLO, TERESA DBA MOLTE COSA AND BELLA COSE

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PROOF OF SERVICE IS DEFECTIVE AS IT LACKS DATE AND PLACE OF MAILING, DEFENDANT WAS SERVED BY SUBSTITUTE SERVICE. PLAINTIFF WAS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF MUST RE-SERVE THE DEFENDANT PRIOR TO THE NEXT HEARING DATE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (D-506)
